description: What do I need to know to move USDC on Base: chain facts, USDC token facts and which providers on-ramp or off-ramp there? Paid ($0.01 USDC): One call, three cited datasets for Base: the /v1/chain record, the /v1/token record for USDC on Base, and every dataset provider that lists Base and on-ramp and/or off-ramp (id, name, onramp/offramp flags, source_url, retrieved_at, quote, confidence). Includes as_of and a sources list. No parameters. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/pack/base. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL. Paid: $0.01 per call (x402/MPP).
name: get_base_pack
